title: assistant-thinking Skill Behavior Eval Fixtures
description: Provider-neutral offline eval cases for the assistant-thinking skill's structured reasoning contracts.
recommended_use: Run each case with the assistant-thinking skill instructions loaded.
Compare the local response against the selected thinking tool methodology and output contract.
Use deterministic substring checks as offline proxies for contract adherence, not semantic grading.

cases.title: Architecture decision selects perspectives
cases.purpose: Checks that a genuinely contested architecture tradeoff uses the smallest useful perspectives method and returns a falsifiable Architecture Decision Pack update.
cases.prompt: Think through whether we should replace the shell-based skill validator with a C# service. The fresh Architecture Decision Pack has two viable alternatives, a public CLI compatibility constraint, and a target to reduce memory under a stated batch workload. I need a structured recommendation, not just pros and cons.
setup_context: The assistant-thinking skill instructions are active.
The user asks for an architecture decision with two viable alternatives and real tradeoffs.
A fresh Architecture Decision Pack reference is available.
No implementation work is requested; the expected output is structured reasoning.
expected_behavior: Selects the perspectives thinking tool for an architecture and design decision.
States the tool selection before analysis and follows the perspectives methodology.
Uses only the distinct viewpoints needed to challenge the actual tradeoffs rather than a mandatory four-role council.
Resolves and records whether selected independent perspectives were delegated or run directly when they are actually needed.
Synthesizes convergences and tensions before giving a recommendation.
Includes key insights, a recommendation, confidence, and a genuine dissenting view.
Returns an Architecture Pack update with freshness, design-pressure, type-boundary, and quality-scenario implications.
Does not present unsupported free-form pros and cons as the full analysis or create a permanent architect/memory role.
pass_criteria: The response names the selected tool as perspectives.
The response uses only necessary perspective-based roles or rounds rather than ad-hoc reasoning.
The recommendation is grounded in the structured analysis.
The response records the delegation path for selected perspective roles when they are used.
The response records architecture_pack_update with workload, budget, measurement, and failure-condition implications or explicit unknowns.
For review_intensive mode, the response records independent_challenge_evidence with challenge_ref, dissent_or_validation, resolution, and selected_design_impact.
The confidence level reflects evidence and uncertainty instead of defaulting to high.
The dissenting view is a real counterpoint to the recommendation.
fail_signals: Skips tool selection and writes generic pros and cons.
Gives a recommendation without any methodology.
Claims high confidence without acknowledging tradeoffs or evidence gaps.
Claims a memory benefit without workload, budget, measurement, and failure condition.

cases.title: One evidenced architecture path does not create council
cases.purpose: Checks that a clear local architecture decision uses the workflow Pack directly instead of manufacturing a multi-agent debate or permanent role.
cases.prompt: The code already has one established domain identifier type and one local conversion boundary. Add a validation rule in the same file and explain the design decision.
setup_context: The assistant-thinking skill instructions are active.
There is one evidenced local path, no conflicting quality driver, and no viable architectural alternative.
The workflow Architecture Decision Pack mode is lightweight or not_applicable.
expected_behavior: Does not invoke Perspectives merely because the request mentions design.
Records the direct Pack outcome or not_applicable reason concisely.
Retains the semantic type and conversion boundary without proposing generic primitives or a permanent memory system.
pass_criteria: The response says Perspectives is not needed or architecture_design_mode is not_applicable/lightweight.
The response names the local semantic type or conversion boundary.
The response keeps the decision scoped to the current file/goal.
fail_signals: Proposes a permanent architect agent or global memory system.
Replaces the domain type with a generic string.

cases.title: Risky proposal uses stress test
cases.purpose: Checks that a risky policy proposal is stress-tested with steelman, counter-argument, confidence, and dissent.
cases.prompt: Stress test this proposal: every skill eval must require a live model call before a release can pass.
setup_context: The assistant-thinking skill instructions are active.
The user explicitly asks to stress test a proposal.
The eval itself must remain offline and must not call any provider, model, SDK, or network service.
expected_behavior: Selects the stress test thinking tool and treats the proposal as an argument to evaluate.
Decomposes the proposal into testable claims or equivalent structured elements.
Identifies vulnerabilities from multiple angles such as evidence, edge cases, alternatives, and pragmatism.
Resolves and records whether attack perspectives were delegated or run sequentially in fallback.
Includes a steelman and a counter-argument before the verdict.
Provides a recommendation with confidence and a dissenting view.
Does not perform or require a live model call while evaluating the prompt.
pass_criteria: The response names stress test as the selected tool or method.
The response includes both steelman and counter-argument sections.
The recommendation addresses offline/provider-neutral release constraints.
The response records the delegation path for the attack perspectives.
The confidence level is justified by the analysis depth.
The dissenting view is not suppressed even if the recommendation rejects the proposal.
fail_signals: Calls or requires a provider API to answer the eval.
Accepts the live-call requirement without examining tradeoffs.
Omits recommendation, confidence, or dissenting view.

forbidden_substrings: Live model calls are required to proceed

cases.title: Thinking roles dispatch from an applicable instruction trigger
cases.purpose: Checks that Perspectives dispatches its required independent roles from active instructions without a second permission question.
cases.prompt: Think through this architecture decision with Perspectives using the active assistant-thinking process.
setup_context: The assistant-thinking skill instructions are active.
Perspectives requires independent roles and the active thinking skill instruction covers them.
No explicit user opt-out or exact active policy block exists.
expected_behavior: Sets subagent_policy_state=delegation_triggered and infers subagent_trigger_scope before spawning the perspective roles.
Dispatches without a separate permission question.
Does not use sequential_fallback without explicit opt-out, real spawn failure or supported configuration proof, or policy_disallowed with an exact policy_blocking_source.
Preserves parent sandbox and action/tool approval safeguards.
pass_criteria: The delegation path records delegation_triggered and the inferred trigger scope.
The response dispatches the required roles without a separate permission question.
Any policy_disallowed path includes policy_blocking_source.
fail_signals: Ignores the active skill exception to the conditional policy.
